Class ScenarioValidationHelper

java.lang.Object
org.ether.society.ui.scenario.ScenarioValidationHelper
public final class ScenarioValidationHelper extends Object
Validates scenario parameters across planetary context, resource distribution, demographics, temporal bounds, and cultural tensor raster layers.

Enforces physical and simulation invariants before initiating compute passes or saving presets. Highlights invalid controls with visual warnings and maintains the error banner state.

Version:
1.0.0-beta.2
Author:
